description: Confirm the toolchain and baseline are green before any change. The orchestrator already installed Flutter 3.38.10 (pinned to CI) at /opt/flutter and npm at /opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin, and ran backend npm ci + flutter pub get. This feature re-confirms the baseline so later features build on a known-green state. No source changes. No commit is required for this feature (nothing to commit); it only establishes the baseline.
steps: Export the backend toolchain: `export PATH=/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH`. From backend/, run `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm run test`. Confirm all pass (expect 275 tests, 36 files).

Export flutter: `export PATH=/opt/flutter/bin:$PATH`. Confirm `flutter --version` reports 3.38.10 / Dart 3.10.9. If flutter is missing, re-install: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git /opt/flutter`, then `cd /opt/flutter && git fetch --depth 1 origin refs/tags/3.38.10:refs/tags/3.38.10 && git checkout 3.38.10`, then `flutter --version` to bootstrap and `flutter config --no-analytics`.

From app/, run `flutter pub get` then `git checkout analysis_options.yaml pubspec.lock` to drop Flutter's auto-rewrite side effects. Run `flutter analyze --fatal-infos` (expect: No issues found!), `flutter test` (expect: All tests passed!), and `dart run tool/lint_ui_copy.dart lib` (expect: OK, no forbidden dashes).
From packages/flutter_ring_captions/, run `flutter pub get` then `git checkout pubspec.lock`, then `flutter analyze --fatal-infos` and `flutter test`. Confirm both are green.
Confirm the working tree is clean (`git status --short` empty) and the current branch is fix/audit-findings-remediation.
acceptance_criteria: backend npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run test all exit 0 (275 tests pass).
app flutter analyze --fatal-infos prints 'No issues found!', flutter test prints 'All tests passed!', and the UI-copy lint prints OK.
packages/flutter_ring_captions flutter analyze --fatal-infos and flutter test both pass.
git status --short is empty and the branch is fix/audit-findings-remediation.
verification: export PATH=/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH && cd backend && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test

export PATH=/opt/flutter/bin:$PATH && cd app && flutter pub get && git checkout analysis_options.yaml pubspec.lock && flutter analyze --fatal-infos && flutter test && dart run tool/lint_ui_copy.dart lib
export PATH=/opt/flutter/bin:$PATH && cd packages/flutter_ring_captions && flutter pub get && git checkout pubspec.lock && flutter analyze --fatal-infos && flutter test
findings: Baseline verified green by the architect before delegation. Toolchain installed: Flutter 3.38.10 (Dart 3.10.9) at /opt/flutter via git clone + checkout tag 3.38.10 + bootstrap + flutter config --no-analytics; npm 11.4.2 / node 22 at /opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin; backend deps via npm ci; app + package deps via flutter pub get. Results: backend npm run typecheck PASS, npm run lint PASS, npm run test PASS (275 tests, 36 files). app flutter analyze --fatal-infos 'No issues found!', flutter test 'All tests passed!', UI-copy lint OK. package flutter analyze clean + flutter test all passed. IMPORTANT: Flutter is pinned to 3.38.10 to match CI; a newer Flutter (e.g. 3.47.x) produces 8 spurious analyze deprecation infos and 1 Semantics test failure that are NOT real regressions. Branch fix/audit-findings-remediation created off main (HEAD 8992744). No commit needed for this feature.
